scope: Documentation-only task sizing; no implementation, runtime qualification or architecture-file edits.

contractKey: true means a new/changed published schema is needed, not permission to relax review or safety.
ownerSentences: 1. Presentation starts with nothing prepared on the runtime.
2. Our selected NYC and Indian files enter live through product routes.
3. A judge's unseen file enters without a code change and its meaning is reviewed.
4. With the model or without it, the file gets in.
5. Large files are drawn/listed in parts steadily, without freezing.

architectureSection3Classification.note: Existing bytes routes reused; new batch/item/unknown-provenance shape, not a competing uploader.
Sniffer dispatch is additive code; durable parent/member items need a contract.
Reuse inventories/profiles; common card/index is new, bounded, source-cited.
Reuse sufficiency; triage/held/ask disposition needs one common shape.
Scheduling existing windows is additive; whole-lane coverage and raised limits change contracts.
Reuse ladder; operational table authority and cross-kind meaning/unknown outputs change contracts.
Minimum adapter joins existing reads/events; optional shared candidate-view contract is additive.
Reuse fusion; arrival-driven index/link candidates add state/reads, not ownership facts.
Extend reviewed batch coverage/decisions in one registry authority; never auto-record.
